newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine June consumer inflation 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine June consumer inflation 0.2 pct.

text.p: Argentine consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in June compared to zero inflation in June last year and a 0.1 percent drop in May this year, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
Wholesale prices fell 0.4 percent in June, compared to a 0.8 percent drop in June last year and a 0.7 percent rise in May this year.
Annualized inflation in June was 0.9 percent, versus 0.1 percent deflation in June last year and 0.7 percent year-on-year inflation in May this year.

Accumulated inflation for the first six months of the year was 0.2 percent, versus accumulated January-June deflation of 0.7 percent last year and accumulated January-May deflation this year of 0.1 percent.
For wholesale prices, June showed annualized deflation of 0.1 percent compared to annualized inflation of 2.6 percent in June last year and annualized deflation of 0.4 percent in May.
